column2: Ghal Bol — u messenger ba la encrypt
Ka jingiakren ba la encrypt kaba jong phi.
Ka ktien bad ki jingkren sur/video 1:1 — khlem number phone, ki key bad ki transcript ha ka device jong phi.
Ghal Bol: ha ka por shisha, private, ki khubor bad ki jingkren na ka device sha ka device

Ka jingpule kaba mih hapoh ka mar Ghal Bol — ka ktien ba la encrypt na ka device sha ka device, ki receipt pynpoi bad pule, bad ki jingkren sur bad video kiba long na ka bynta ki ba don ha ka internet. Ka kyrteng pule ka app ka long Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Ka jingiakren na ka dur sha ka dur
Ki khubor ki long ba la seal ha ka device jong phi. Ka synduk pynpoi ka bat tang ka ktien ba la encrypt kaba khlem jingshai haduh ba u nongioh u pynskhem.
Ki jingkren ki iasoh na ka device sha ka device ha LAN haba lah, lane da ka jingkynthup ba kham kham kaba khlem pynphai media.
Ka jinglong ba ka device ka ioh
Ka install baroh ka thaw ka jinglong ba la encrypt na ka jaka. Khot da QR ne ka link — khlem number phone bad khlem login social.
Scan shisien. Iasoh haba phi don ha ka internet.
U nongwan u scan QR u nongshong (ne u plie ka link khot). U nongwan u thap ka public key u nongshong bad u phone. QR na ki arli khlem donkam.
Iasam ka link jong phi https://ghalbol.com/connect/… ne QR na Khot ha Ghal Bol.
Ki plie ia ka ha Ghal Bol (ne ki install shwa na Play / Linux).
Haba ki ar ngut ki lah ban poi, ka jingiakren bad ki jingkren ki iasoh — na ka bynta ki jingkren ki lynti LAN bad WAN ki iaid lang.
Ki package Windows ki long ba la tei na ka jaka kam kaba dei. Ka download pule ha kane ka jaka ka long ka package desktop Linux; Android ka mih ha Google Play kum com.ghalbol.
Install Ghal Bol na Play. Ki App Links ba la pynskhem ki plie ki khot beit ha ka app haba lah.
Pynmih ka archive release, hadien ./install.sh (na ka bynta u nongpyndonkam) ne ./run.sh ban pyrshang ha ka jaka.
Ka mar, ka kompani, ka mar

Gotigin ka long ka mar (Haba ka teknologi i iakynduh bad ka jingshem). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED ka long ka kompani. Ghal Bol ka long ka mar na ka bynta ki jingpule iti khubor; kane ka jaka ka long ghalbol.com. U messenger ka long kaba mih mynta. Ki kyrteng package bad ka domain ki sah ghalbol — ka ktien wei. Ym don ka mar camel-case ba pher.
Ghal Bol na ka bynta Linux
Ka package production x86_64. Pynmih ka archive hadien pynlong ./install.sh (na ka bynta u nongpyndonkam, ha ~/.local) ne ./run.sh ban pyrshang ha ka jaka.
La plie hapoh ka app bawei (kum WhatsApp)
Kane ka browser ba la tei kam lah ban plie Ghal Bol. Ktah ka menu bad plie kane ka slaid ha Chrome, ne copy ka link ka app bad paste ha Ghal Bol → Rung.
Hapoh ktah Plie ha Ghal Bol. Lada ym don jingjia, copy ka link ka app bad paste ha Ghal Bol (Rung).
Rung na ka bynta Ghal Bol. Ki jingsynshar baroh — ka email, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, ne ka phone.
Bteng da ka email, u nongai, lane ka phone.
Phah biang ia ka email jingpynshisha
Thoh ia ka address email ba dei.
Pyndonkam ia ka ktien rieh ba don 6 ki dak lane kham bun.
Ka email lane ka ktien rieh ka bakla.
La khang ia ka window jingrung.
Kane ka domain kam don jingbit na ka bynta Firebase Auth.
Kata ka lad ban rung kam pat sdang.
Bun palat ki jingpyrshang. Pyrshang biang hadien.
Pyndonkam ia u nombar phone baroh bad u code ri (kum +91…).
Uta u code SMS u bakla lane u la kut ka por.
Don ei ei kaba la bakla.
Ym pat pynshisha ia ka email — peit ia ka inbox jong phi
La phah ka email pynskhem — peit ia ka inbox jong phi
Ym shem ka slaid — Ghal Bol
Ym don eiei ha kane ka address. Ka link khot ka ieng kum ghalbol.com/connect/… — peit ba la copy baroh.
